rubric_notes: All must_include met: SCOPe 2.08 a.22.1 (SUNID 47113) with families a.22.1.1-4 plus a.22.1.0, all SUNIDs match bundle; superfamily supports probable common ancestry; family level is closer; explicit refusal to transfer nucleosome/DNA-packaging/oligomeric/catalytic function without external evidence. Correctly separates linker H1/H5 (a.4.5.13, winged helix) and name-matched enzymes (Dot1l c.66.1.31, HDAC8 c.42.1.2) and adds the caveat that separate placement is not proof of non-homology. Minor phrasing nit: limits of transfer framed as 'shared fold/class' rather than superfamily, but the family-vs-superfamily distinction is stated elsewhere. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct families a.204.1.2 (MazG-like) and a.204.1.4 (HisE-like), shared superfamily a.204.1 and fold a.204 with SUNIDs, domain descriptions and release 2.08 all supported by the evidence bundle. Correctly locates the homology inference at the superfamily level, notes the fold-level non-homology warning, rejects transfer of HisE/MazG substrate, reaction, regulation, oligomeric state and template suitability in both directions, and lists needed external evidence. All must_include items met, no must_avoid violations. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-16.

Correct families c.55.1.1/53068, c.55.1.3/53083, c.55.1.4/53089 under superfamily c.55.1/53067, fold c.55, class c; all supported by bundle. States remote homology and rejects transfer of substrate, reaction, ligand, regulation, oligomeric state, whole-protein role and templates, with external evidence types. Omits the inference of a conserved structural/mechanistic nucleotide-binding core (scoring_focus mechanistic inference), so reasoning is mostly rather than fully complete. Duplication comment correctly cited.

Complete: correct family, superfamily, fold, and class SUNIDs; superfamily as the shared homology-bearing level; family boundaries as the limit on function transfer; cites bundle-supported bimetal-centre and four-helix-bundle annotations without over-reading them; lists required external evidence; correctly characterises the Pfam PF05067 mapping comment as provenance only. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16. Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily b.6.1, fold b.6, class b (all verified in bundle). States probable common ancestry at superfamily level while keeping distinct families; correctly disambiguates ephrin ectodomain from ephrin receptor hits. Cites both family annotations lacking the metal-binding site and the superfamily copper-site comment. Explicitly rejects copper/electron-transfer transfer and lists required external evidence (conserved ligands in structural context, metal-bound structure/spectroscopy, redox assays). Complete.

All codes and SUNIDs correct and evidence-supported, including the fold core comment and the above-superfamily homology warning. States superfamily-level common ancestry and rejects transfer of covalent modifier, conjugation pathway, and Ras/GTPase binding annotations. Does not explicitly address p97/VCP binding as a UBX-specific, non-transferable function.

Correct release 2.08 identifiers for all three families, superfamily 52172, fold c.23, class c, all supported by sccs parents responses in the bundle. Distinguishes fold (topological context) from superfamily (evolutionary-strength claim) and supports probable common ancestry at superfamily level, not same family. Comprehensive rejection of transferred signaling, receiver phosphorylation, circadian role, ODC catalysis, PLP chemistry, oligomeric state and template interchangeability. KaiA 'lacks canonical receiver-domain features' comment supported by 82344 annotations. Names external evidence required. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Correct placement (310706 under family 310616, superfamily 310577 b.84.5, fold 51229 b.84 with five superfamilies), fold architecture annotation, asymmetric evolutionary claim: homology within superfamily/family, explicitly not implied above superfamily, and neither homology nor nonhomology/convergence established with b.84.1-b.84.4. Rejects template/function transfer, flags PubMed 19893485 as uninspected. All supported by bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Complete. Correct release (2.08), SCCS and SUNIDs for f.21 (81344), f.21.1 (81342), f.21.2 (81343), f.21.3 (103501), class f; fold comment and homology warning accurately reported from bundle; f.21.3 'possible link' comment cited and correctly interpreted as not merging. Explicitly rejects both merging and treating separation as proof of independent origin; lists structural alignment, sequence/motif, phylogenetic, biochemical/literature evidence. Rejects unsafe functional/template transfer. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Complete and accurate: three families with SUNIDs under c.2.1/51735, fold c.2/51734, class c/51349, all supported by the bundle. Identifies superfamily as the deepest homology-bearing node, notes the fold-level warning, rejects transfer of reaction chemistry, CoA binding, channel gating, NAD/NADP specificity, oligomeric state and whole-protein function, cites the c.2.1.1 comment and PF02254 mapping correctly, and lists external evidence types.

Correct lineage (k/k.40/k.40.1/k.40.1.1), correct SUNIDs, cites family 100905 'not a true family' and warns against ordinary family-level transfer. However leads with 'Yes' homologous and justifies homology-level placement from the shared superfamily k.40.1, which for designed proteins is just as nominal as the flagged family; the calibrated claim should be that homology is not established and the safe description is a designed structural grouping. Violates must_avoid in spirit (claiming shared SCOPe level proves ancestry). Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include met: 1.69 d1t1ja_/d1t1jb_ c.137/c.137.1/c.137.1.1 vs d1f8ya_/d1f8yb_ c.23/c.23.14/c.23.14.1 (shared only class c); 2.08 d1t1ja1/d1t1jb1 residues 1-118 in c.23.14.2 sharing homology-bearing superfamily c.23.14 with 1f8y in c.23.14.1. Interprets the change as a new probable-common-ancestry hypothesis at superfamily level, lists what cannot be transferred, notes the API does not verify the paper's rationale, and correctly cites release 2.08 with periodic update. All claims supported by its bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All must_include met: d1a14h2 H:1-8, l.1.1.1, class l Artifacts, Tags lineage, N-terminal Tags, Synthetic species; d1a14h1 H:9-111, b.1.1.1. Cites homology_implied_by_level=false and the artifact warning (supported by bundle), concludes similarity at most indicates shared tag sequence, and rejects transfer of antibody homology, function, or template evidence without independent evidence from the real domain. No must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

Correct 1.75 single d1acca_ f.11.1.1; split starting 2.04 through 2.08 into d1acca1 A:226-735 f.60.1.1 and d1acca2 A:14-225 b.179.1.1, SUNIDs correct. Treats domains as units of homology, warns against whole-chain and cross-module transfer, states curator-rationale limit. Complete and accurate.

Correct five-domain decomposition with SIDs, boundaries, SCCS, families and superfamilies; d3jb9a5 A:47-697 identified as the Prp8-specific new fold d.394, with the single-child-superfamily observation supported by the children endpoint in the bundle. Clear mosaic interpretation, homology-bearing-level caveats, explicit rejection of catalytic/ligand function transfer and whole-protein template use, and a caution against overstating independent origins.

Correct full hierarchy with SUNIDs, Pfam PF03377 superfamily repeat annotation, 4cj9 A:259-292 representative, re heterogeneity on d2kq5a_/d3v6pa_, and the 'single repeat' comment. Explains length tracks repeat count and lists unsafe transfers; honest that the API lacks exact residue counts.

Accurate, bundle-supported release metadata including api_url and stable label. Cites 2.08 for reproducibility and says to preserve the dated label when specifically using that update; rejects treating the periodic update as a replacement for the stable release. Omits the meaning of the periodic label as additions of newly classified PDB entries without rewriting stable-release domains. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Fully supported facts: a.47.2.1 for all domains, three-helical fragment/spectrin comment and ms record on 1br0/1ez3, absence of that record on d1dn1b_, automated-matches 'not a true protein' provenance correctly interpreted, STAT-like fold a.47. Rejects spectrin-repeat homology and fragment-only exemplars and asks for full-domain coverage/external evidence. Does not state what the complete domain shows (four-long-helix bundle) and so does not explicitly explain how the full structure resolves the fragment-driven resemblance. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Names five distinct lineages (c.2.1, c.25.1, c.1.7, c.77.1, b.43.4.1) all verified in its bundle; correctly frames convergent acquisition across folds while stating SCOPe placement alone does not prove independent origin; family > superfamily > fold/class homology semantics correct; lists integrated external evidence and rejects function/template transfer. All must_include met, no must_avoid violations. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-16.

Correct release change, shared superfamily vs separate families, PMID 17977833 bridge. Correctly flags d1nqdb2 as an l.1.1.1 tag artifact excluded from the homology comparison. Remote-ancestry inference with function-transfer limits.

Complete: 2.08 lineage with SUNIDs 46688/46689/46690 supported by bundle; hf correctly defined as domain-level heterogeneous fold that does not remove family/superfamily homology. Rejects template swapping, pooling as uncomplicated positives, and detailed structure/function transfer; requires preserving the hf label plus external alignment, boundary, and biochemical evidence. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

Correct boundaries, lineage, release and fr definition; d1uc6a1 unflagged. Align only over covered core; absent region not read as deletions or divergence; fragment stratified/filtered; correctly notes 1o5d has higher SPACI/AEROSPACI than 1uc6 and that this does not override missing coverage; diversity and function-transfer caveats. Does not make the positive recommendation that a complete adequate-quality domain should be the default representative, only says the fragment should not be the sole one; quality values and method not quoted; score-comparability point only implicit. No errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-16.

Complete: new superfamily in existing fold; cf as structural level and sf/fa as homology-bearing levels consistent with /api/v1/levels bundle; family too strong because it asserts common ancestry and closer relationship; new fold wrong if the fold match is real (requires non-matching topology); explicitly states this is not proof of nonhomology or convergence and lists evidence needed for stronger placement. Function/template transfer caveats included. No factual errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-16.

All classifications verified against the bundle: SCOPe 2.08, superfamily d.144.1 (56112), fold d.144 (56111), families d.144.1.4 (56171), d.144.1.6 (64411), d.144.1.7 (88854). States probable common ancestry versus mere fold similarity; explicitly rejects APH->protein-kinase specificity/regulation, protein-kinase->APH antibiotic specificity, and PI3K lipid/regulatory-domain transfer; lists sequence/active-site conservation, ligand-bound structures, structural alignment, biochemical assays, domain-context and phylogenetic evidence. ATP-grasp/PIPK superfamily comment is supported by the annotations endpoint and correctly caveated. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1; 2026-10-16.
